arxiv-2212-02599.title: On the Evolution of States in a Quantum-Mechanical Model of Experiments
arxiv-2212-02599.creator: Jürg Fröhlich, Zhou Gang
arxiv-2212-02599.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jürg Fröhlich, Zhou Gang. The postulates of von Neumann and Lüders concerning measurements in quantum mechanics are discussed and criticized in the context of a simple model proposed in [ 1 ] . The main purpose of our paper is to analyze some mathematical aspects of that model and to draw some general lessons on the so-called “measurement problem” in quantum mechanics pointing towards the need to introduce general principles that determine the law for the stochastic time evolution of states of individual physical

arxiv-2303-14784.title: A spatial measure-valued model for radiation-induced DNA damage kinetics and repair under protracted irradiation condition
arxiv-2303-14784.creator: Francesco G. Cordoni
arxiv-2303-14784.description: Abstract In the present work, we develop a general spatial stochastic model to describe the formation and repair of radiation-induced DNA damage. The model is described mathematically as a measure-valued particle-based stochastic system and extends in several directions the model developed in [ Cordoni et al., 2021 , Cordoni et al., 2022b , Cordoni et al., 2022a ] .

arxiv-2402-19279.title: SIFT-Aided Rectified 2D-DIC for Displacement and Strain Measurements in Asphalt Concrete Testing
arxiv-2402-19279.creator: Zehui Zhu, Imad L. Al-Qadi
arxiv-2402-19279.description: Abstract Two-dimensional digital image correlation (2D-DIC) is a widely used optical technique to measure displacement and strain during asphalt concrete (AC) testing. An accurate 2-D DIC measurement can only be achieved when the camera’s principal axis is perpendicular to the planar specimen surface. However, this requirement may not be met during testing due to device constraints.

arxiv-2405-01361.title: Haptic-Based Bilateral Teleoperation of Aerial Manipulator for Extracting Wedged Object with Compensation of Human Reaction Time
arxiv-2405-01361.creator: Jeonghyun Byun, Dohyun Eom, H. Jin Kim
arxiv-2405-01361.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jeonghyun Byun, Dohyun Eom, H. Jin Kim. Bilateral teleoperation of an aerial manipulator facilitates the execution of industrial missions thanks to the combination of the aerial platform’s maneuverability and the ability to conduct complex tasks with human supervision. Heretofore, research on such operations has focused on flying without any physical interaction or exerting a pushing force on a contact surface that does not involve abrupt changes in the interaction force.

arxiv-2406-00996.title: Focusing Airborne Ultrasound with Partially Occluded Emission from Rectangular Plate with Flexural Vibration Mode
arxiv-2406-00996.creator: Keisuke Hasegawa*, Masaya Fujimori*, Masaya Takasaki
arxiv-2406-00996.description: Abstract Abstract We propose a focusing method of intense midair ultrasound out of ultrasonic emission from a single flexurally vibrating square plate partially covered with a purposely designed amplitude mask. Many applications relying on nonlinear acoustic effects, such as radiation force employed in acoustic levitation, have been devised.

arxiv-2505-07472.description: Abstract Solar Orbiter conducted a series of flare-optimised observing campaigns in 2024 utilising the Major Flare Solar Orbiter Observing Plan (SOOP). pmc-12632069.title: Prediction of three-dimensional dose distribution for patient-specific quality assurance based on log files using WingsNet
pmc-12632069.creator: Ying Huang, Yifei Pi, Ruxin Cai, Kui Ma, Hao Wang, Hua Chen, Hengle Gu, Yan Shao, Aihui Feng, Yanhua Duan, Zhenjiong Shen, Qing Kong, Zhiyong Xu, Weihai Zhuo
pmc-12632069.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThis study aims to construct and train the WingsNet model, which leverages the parameters recorded in log files to rapidly and accurately predict the patient-specific three-dimensional (3D) dose distribution for IMRT quality assurance (QA).MethodsWe conducted a retrospective analysis of data from 286 lung cancer patients treated with a prescription of 60 Gy in 30 fractions, with 242 cases used for model training and 44 for testing.

pmc-13039603.title: Botulinum toxin injection induced autoimmune thyroiditis and myxedema coma: A case report
pmc-13039603.creator: Khaled Gazwi, Tareq Zaza, Hassan Mitwally, Nikeshkumar Davda, Adel Ganaw
pmc-13039603.description: This case describes a 28-year-old female with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and recurrent urinary tract infections who developed myxedema coma following a botulinum toxin type-A (Btx) injection for muscle spasticity. On intensive care unit admission, she presented with hypothermia, bradycardia, and reduced consciousness. Laboratory evaluation revealed markedly elevated thyroid-stimulating hormone levels, confirming myxedema coma.
